# Version 3.116.1
> **Android native asset compatibility** · Released December 5, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.1 adds 16 KB Android native-library alignment and corrects package path metadata.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Platform

- **16 KB Android page alignment** — Android native libraries are built with NDK r27c and 16 KB alignment for devices using larger memory pages. ([#3098](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3098))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct package destination metadata** — Native asset packaging uses the correct PackagePath attribute rather than the misspelled PackageFile attribute. ([#3102](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3102))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0.1

HarfBuzzSharp receives the same Android 16 KB alignment and package-path metadata corrections. The 8.3.0.1 package revision is not a native engine upgrade.
